text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin has won the
Arima!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Siiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Congrats! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that Ines's little sister? Well,
Ines sure
was amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Totally. I think seeing her run like that gave me the strength to actually get through all my snoozefest shifts.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Pretty brave of you to say that with
me
standing right here.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec! I didn't mean it that way! I
just
meant I feel like I can get through
anything life
throws at me!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I know what you mean.
Watching Ines run
really does make you
feel alive, huh?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Totally. Makes me feel like we should be chasing after our dreams too—like, for real.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I guess you're carrying a lot of weight
too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wha?! H-hi, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I need to move forward too. I want to let
them
dream again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like this isn't over after all.
Not
yet. Let's
meet again, Ines. Right here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: O-okay? ...I'm looking forward to it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let them dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Sis...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Keep running a whole lot, okay? Me and
Polly...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
We love you! And we love how hard you
work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I will.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But can I ask you two a favor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Cassie, Polly, I want you to keep helping
me out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can take care of things
around
the house for now? That way I
can keep on racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you two?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Let's run carrying their dreams wi...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
choice_data_list: Let's keep running and having fun.
